annotation.title_clean: Article 26: Obligations of deployers of high-risk AI systems
annotation.title_en: Article 26: Obligations of deployers of high-risk AI systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, AI Act Service Desk
annotation.summary_en: Official AI Act Service Desk page reproducing Article 26 of the EU AI Act (consolidated, with Digital Omnibus markings), setting obligations for deployers of high-risk AI systems: use per instructions, competent human oversight, input data quality, monitoring, log retention, incident reporting, worker information, and safeguards for post-remote biometric identification.
key_provisions_or_claims: Deployers must use high-risk AI per provider instructions with technical and organisational measures
Human oversight must be assigned to competent, trained, authorised persons
Deployers monitor operation, keep logs at least six months, and report risks and serious incidents
Workers and representatives must be informed before workplace use
Post-remote biometric identification by law enforcement needs prior authorisation, documentation and annual reports
